title: TroveManager does not work with non-18 decimal tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The `_redeemCollateralFromTrove()` function, used internally by `redeemCollateral()`, assumes all collateral tokens have 18 decimals, matching the debt token.
